objective.statement: Grow the iOS and Android habit-tracking mobile app for busy professionals from 200 to 600 active paying subscribers and from $4,000 to $12,000 MRR within 7 days by rapidly improving activation, trial starts, trial-to-paid conversion, ASO, lifecycle messaging drafts, approved paid acquisition, and approved pricing or offer experiments.
success: Active paying subscribers increase from 200 to at least 600 by the end of day 7, verified in Stripe.
MRR increases from $4,000 to at least $12,000 by the end of day 7, verified in Stripe.
Activation rate improves from approximately 30% to at least 40% of new installs within the 7-day launch window, verified in Mixpanel.
Paid trial start rate improves from approximately 4% to at least 8% of activated users, verified in Mixpanel.
Trial-to-paid conversion rate is maintained at or above 50% while scaling trial starts, verified through Mixpanel and Stripe cohort reporting.
At least one owner-approved ASO, lifecycle email, paid campaign, or pricing/offer experiment produces a measurable lift against its primary metric with before/after evidence.
Daily summary and Mixpanel dashboard evidence are delivered every day during the 7-day sprint.
failure: Active paying subscribers remain below 600 at the end of day 7.
MRR remains below $12,000 at the end of day 7.
Any paid ad spend exceeds $50/day without owner approval or violates the $2,000/month hard cap.
Any mass email, live pricing change, discount, or direct user message is sent without owner approval.
Any campaign, ASO copy, lifecycle message, or ad creative makes health claims or targets under-18 users.
Discounting exceeds 30% on any offer, promotion, campaign, lifecycle message, or pricing test.
Daily proof is missing for any sprint day, including Mixpanel dashboard evidence, before/after metrics, and campaign or experiment logs.
constraints: Time horizon is exactly 7 days; speed matters more than caution within the stated approval limits.
No health claims may be made in any App Store, Play Store, lifecycle, ad, social, Intercom, or in-app copy.
Never target under-18 users in paid ads, organic content, messaging, segmentation, or experimentation.
Ad spend is capped at $2,000/month total and any ad spend above $50/day requires owner approval before launch.
Owner approval is required before any mass email in Customer.io.
Owner approval is required before any direct user messaging through Intercom, Customer.io, or in-app messaging.
Owner approval is required before any live pricing change.
The assistant may draft ASO copy, analyze Mixpanel funnels, draft lifecycle emails, and propose A/B and pricing experiments without external side effects.
External side effects must stay approval-gated unless explicitly allowed by the owner.

profiles.ceo: Owns the 7-day subscriber and MRR outcome, prioritizes speed, decides which growth bets to propose for owner approval, and enforces all approval gates and hard stops.
profiles.optimizer: Continuously reviews Mixpanel, Stripe, campaign, and lifecycle evidence; adjusts safe tunables within approved bounds to maximize activation, trial starts, and trial-to-paid conversion.
profiles.worker: Executes analysis, drafts assets, prepares experiment plans, assembles proof, and queues approval-ready changes for App Store, Play Store, Customer.io, Meta, Google Ads, Instagram, TikTok, Intercom, and Stripe.

Mixpanel.use: Read-only funnel, cohort, activation, trial-start, and conversion analysis; dashboard screenshots or links for proof.

Stripe.use: Read-only verification of active paying subscribers, MRR, trials, conversions, churn, and pricing state unless owner approves pricing changes.

Customer.io.use: Draft lifecycle emails and segmentation plans; queue but do not send mass emails without owner approval.

Meta Ads.use: Draft and configure campaigns, audiences, budget pacing, and creatives for busy professionals; launching or spending above limits is gated.
approval_required_for: any campaign that could exceed $2,000/month cap
new live campaign launch if not pre-approved

Google Ads.use: Draft and configure search/app campaigns, keywords, negative targeting, budgets, and creatives; launching or spending above limits is gated.
approval_required_for: any campaign that could exceed $2,000/month cap
new live campaign launch if not pre-approved

App Store.use: Draft ASO copy, keyword hypotheses, screenshots messaging, and conversion experiment plans for the iOS app.

Play Store.use: Draft ASO copy, keyword hypotheses, screenshots messaging, and conversion experiment plans for the Android app.

Instagram.use: Draft organic content ideas and captions for busy professionals focused on streaks, smart nudges, and weekly AI coaching.

TikTok.use: Draft organic short-form scripts and content hooks for busy professionals focused on habit consistency and productivity.

Intercom.use: Analyze support themes if available and draft targeted messages; no direct user messaging without approval.

global_rules: Do not target under-18s in any provider.
Do not make health claims in any provider.
Do not exceed $50/day ad spend without owner approval.
Do not exceed $2,000/month ad spend under any circumstance.
Keep audit logs of all drafts, proposed changes, approvals, launches, and measured outcomes.

capabilities: Analyze Mixpanel activation, trial-start, and trial-to-paid funnels.
Compare pre-sprint baselines to daily changes.
Segment users by install source, platform, activation status, trial status, and conversion status.
Identify the largest drop-offs at activation and trial-to-paid.
allowed_side_effects: Read Stripe subscription and MRR data.
Create internal reports, dashboards, and recommendations.
required_proof: segment-level finding with sample size and date range

capabilities: Draft Customer.io lifecycle emails for activation, trial-start nudges, trial conversion, and weekly AI coaching value communication.
Draft Intercom or in-app message copy for owner review.
Draft subject lines, preview text, calls to action, and segmentation rules.
required_proof: compliance check for no health claims, no under-18 targeting, and discount cap

capabilities: Draft App Store and Play Store listing copy improvements.
Propose keyword tests for busy professionals, habit streaks, smart nudges, and weekly AI coaching.
required_proof: expected impact on install-to-activation or store conversion

capabilities: Draft Meta and Google Ads campaign structures.
Propose budget pacing within the $50/day approval-free ceiling and $2,000/month hard cap.
Draft creatives and copy for busy professionals.
Monitor CAC, trial-start rate, and paid subscriber conversion for approved campaigns.
allowed_side_effects: Pause or recommend pausing campaigns that breach stop conditions if access and approval policy allow non-expansive risk reduction.

capabilities: Propose pricing, trial, and discount experiments designed to increase trial starts and MRR quickly.
Model MRR impact and risk for discounts up to 30%.
Prepare Stripe implementation instructions for owner approval.
required_proof: owner approval status before any live pricing change

workstreams.purpose: Find and prioritize the fastest fixes for activation and trial-start drop-offs using Mixpanel and Stripe.
Draft Customer.io and Intercom messaging to move activated and unactivated users toward paid trial and paid conversion.
Improve App Store and Play Store acquisition quality and install intent with draft ASO changes.
Use capped Meta and Google Ads experiments to add qualified busy professional users without breaching spend limits.
Propose owner-approved trial, pricing, and discount experiments that can lift paid conversion and MRR within 7 days.
Maintain daily summary, Mixpanel dashboard, campaign logs, approval logs, and hard-stop monitoring.

actions.label: Capture baseline active paying subscribers from Stripe (baseline 200).
Capture baseline MRR from Stripe (baseline $4,000).
Capture baseline Mixpanel funnel: installs, ~30% activation, ~4% trial start, ~50% trial-to-paid.
Create or verify the daily Mixpanel dashboard for installs, activation, trials, conversions, subscribers, MRR proxy, and cohorts.
Create the hard-stop tracker for the $2,000/month cap, $50/day threshold, 30% discount limit, no health claims, and no under-18 targeting.
Analyze Mixpanel activation drop-off by platform, source, first session, and feature exposure.
Analyze trial-start drop-off and trial-to-paid cohorts by source and platform.
Identify the top 3 fastest opportunities likely to move activation, trial starts, or MRR within 7 days.
Draft a ranked sprint plan across ASO, lifecycle email, paid ads, and pricing/offer experiments.
Prepare owner approval requests for any mass email, direct messaging, spend above $50/day, or live pricing change.

stages.label: Days 1-2: draft assets and queue approvals

actions.label: Draft App Store and Play Store ASO copy with no health claims.
Draft Customer.io activation emails for installed-but-not-activated users.
Draft Customer.io trial-start nudges for activated users who have not started a trial.
Draft trial-to-paid conversion emails emphasizing streaks, reminders, and weekly AI coaching value.
Draft Meta and Google Ads campaign copy and audiences excluding under-18s.
Draft pricing or discount experiment proposals with discounts at or below 30%.
Submit approval packets for mass email, direct messaging, spend above $50/day, live pricing changes, and store listing publication.
Launch only owner-approved Customer.io emails, Intercom messages, store changes, pricing changes, or paid campaigns.
Enforce daily spend at or below approved levels and never above the $2,000/month hard cap.
Monitor Mixpanel activation, trial starts, and trial-to-paid movement by campaign, source, platform, and cohort.
Monitor Stripe active paying subscribers and MRR at least daily.
Adjust safe tunables within declared bounds: follow-up timing, nudge count, score threshold, budget pacing, and sample allocation.
Stop or escalate any experiment that approaches a hard stop or produces materially negative signals.
Compare each live experiment against baseline on its primary metric.
Scale winning paid acquisition only within owner-approved daily spend and the $2,000/month cap.
Prepare an urgent owner approval request if scaling requires more than $50/day ad spend.
Cut or pause underperforming campaigns, messages, or offers as a risk-reducing action.
Draft final 48-hour push assets for the highest-performing angle.
Execute only approved final-day actions to maximize paid subscriber and MRR lift.
Verify active paying subscribers and MRR in Stripe.
Verify final activation, trial-start, and trial-to-paid metrics in Mixpanel.
Compile the final proof packet with before/after metrics, logs, approvals, and results.
Deliver the final owner summary with target attainment, failed bets, winning bets, and next steps.

When Mixpanel or Stripe shows a material change in activation, trial starts, paid subscribers, or MRR
stop_conditions: Required Mixpanel or Stripe evidence unavailable and escalated to owner

triggers: Activation rate remains near or below 30%
Paid trial start rate remains near or below 4%
A source or platform cohort materially outperforms the baseline
stop_conditions: Target of 600 active paying subscribers and $12,000 MRR is reached
Next action requires owner approval and approval is not granted

triggers: Approved Meta or Google Ads campaign goes live
Daily spend approaches approved daily budget
CAC, trial-start rate, or paid conversion materially underperforms
stop_conditions: Spend would exceed approved daily budget
Audience includes or could target under-18s

triggers: Owner approves Intercom or direct user messaging
New Mixpanel cohort is identified for activation, trial-start, or trial conversion
stop_conditions: Trial-to-paid conversion drops materially below baseline

triggers: Pricing or discount experiment is proposed
Owner approves a live pricing or discount change
Stripe shows MRR or conversion impact after implementation

approval_gates.required_before: Any Meta or Google Ads campaign launch, budget edit, or scaling action that would spend more than $50/day.
Any paid acquisition action that could cause total ad spend to approach or exceed the $2,000/month hard cap.
Sending any mass email, lifecycle campaign, or automated journey in Customer.io.
Sending any direct user message through Intercom, Customer.io, in-app messaging, Instagram, TikTok, or another user-facing channel.
Changing live Stripe pricing, trial terms, coupons, plan configuration, or any user-facing price.
Publishing or sending any discount offer; discount must be at or below 30% even with approval.
Publishing App Store or Play Store ASO metadata, screenshots, descriptions, or experiment variants.
Posting, commenting, or direct messaging from Instagram or TikTok accounts.

allowed: Analyze Mixpanel funnel, cohort, source, and platform data.
Analyze Stripe active paid subscribers, MRR, trials, conversions, and pricing state in read-only mode.
Draft ASO copy for App Store and Play Store.
Draft Intercom, in-app, Instagram, and TikTok messages without sending or posting.
Draft Meta and Google Ads campaigns, budgets, audiences, and creatives without launching above approval limits.
Propose A/B tests and pricing experiments.

Target under-18 users in any channel or segment.
Offer or publish any discount over 30%.
Exceed the $2,000/month ad spend hard cap.
Send mass emails without owner approval.
Send direct user messages without owner approval.
Change live pricing without owner approval.
Publish App Store or Play Store changes without owner approval.

approval_required: Any action that risks approaching the $2,000/month ad spend cap.
Direct user messaging through Intercom, Customer.io, in-app messaging, Instagram, TikTok, or similar channels.
Coupons, discounts, or promotional offers, capped at 30%.
Publishing App Store or Play Store ASO changes.
Launching or scaling paid campaigns on Meta or Google Ads beyond pre-approved limits.
Posting organic content on Instagram or TikTok.
owner_boundaries: 7-day sprint to reach 600 active paying subscribers and $12,000 MRR.
Speed is prioritized within approval limits.
Daily summary and Mixpanel dashboard proof are mandatory.
Proof must include before/after metrics, campaign logs, and results.

escalation_paths.to: owner for explicit budget approval before launch or scale

escalation_paths.condition: Projected or actual ad spend approaches the $2,000/month hard cap.
escalation_paths.to: ceo profile and owner; pause scale-up until owner confirms compliant plan

escalation_paths.condition: Any mass email, direct message, Intercom message, in-app message, Instagram post, TikTok post, or social DM is ready to send.
escalation_paths.to: owner for approval before sending or posting

escalation_paths.condition: Any live Stripe pricing, coupon, trial, or discount change is recommended.
escalation_paths.to: owner for explicit approval before implementation

escalation_paths.condition: Any draft contains possible health claims or ambiguous wellness claims.
escalation_paths.to: ceo profile for compliance rewrite, then owner if still ambiguous

escalation_paths.condition: Any audience, segment, campaign, or content could target under-18s.
escalation_paths.to: ceo profile for immediate block and owner notification
ceo profile for rejection or redesign within cap

escalation_paths.condition: Mixpanel or Stripe proof is unavailable, inconsistent, or insufficient for daily summary.
escalation_paths.to: owner for data access or instrumentation clarification

escalation_paths.condition: Trial-to-paid conversion falls materially below the approximately 50% baseline after an experiment.
escalation_paths.to: optimizer for immediate diagnosis and ceo profile for cut/rollback recommendation

escalation_paths.condition: Subscriber or MRR trajectory is off pace by day 3 or day 5.
escalation_paths.to: owner with an urgent ranked list of approval-gated acceleration options

lifecycle_followup_delay_hours.controls: How long to wait after install, activation, or trial start before triggering the next drafted lifecycle follow-up once the campaign is owner-approved.

max_lifecycle_nudges_per_user_7_days.controls: Maximum number of owner-approved lifecycle nudges a user can receive during the 7-day sprint to improve activation, trial starts, or trial-to-paid conversion.

trial_start_priority_score_threshold.controls: Minimum lead score for prioritizing activated users for trial-start messaging drafts based on app engagement, source, platform, and exposure to streaks, smart nudges, or weekly AI coaching.

activation_dropoff_alert_threshold_perce.controls: Percentage-point drop or underperformance threshold that triggers optimizer review of activation cohorts in Mixpanel.

paid_campaign_daily_budget_pacing_percen.controls: How aggressively approved Meta and Google Ads budgets are paced against the owner-approved daily budget while staying within the $50/day approval threshold unless additional approval is granted.

experiment_min_sample_size_per_variant.controls: Minimum users or sessions per variant before judging ASO, lifecycle, paid, or funnel experiment results when traffic volume allows during the 7-day window.

winning_experiment_lift_threshold_percen.controls: Minimum relative lift in activation, trial-start rate, paid conversion, or MRR contribution required for the optimizer to recommend doubling down.

paid_campaign_underperformance_cutoff_ho.controls: Number of hours an approved paid campaign may run before being reviewed for pause or revision if spend occurs without sufficient installs, trials, or paid subscribers.

discount_test_percent.controls: Discount percentage to model in pricing or offer experiments; any live use still requires owner approval and can never exceed 30%.

target_platform_focus.controls: Which platform receives priority in analysis, ASO drafting, lifecycle segmentation, and approved campaign focus based on Mixpanel and Stripe performance.

owner_summary.summary: This contract runs a 7-day high-speed growth sprint for the habit-tracking mobile app to move from 200 to 600 active paying subscribers and from $4,000 to $12,000 MRR. The board may analyze Mixpanel and Stripe, draft ASO, lifecycle, ad, social, Intercom, and pricing experiments, and optimize safe tunables. All major external side effects remain gated: ad spend above $50/day, any mass email, direct user messaging, live pricing changes, store listing publication, discounts, and social posting require owner approval. Hard stops are no health claims, never target under-18s, no discounts over 30%, and no ad spend above $2,000/month. Daily proof must include a summary, Mixpanel dashboard evidence, before/after metrics, campaign logs, and results.
